conclusion.text: ELTRON INSTALLASJON AS is an active private limited company in construction, based in Oslo. In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) it reported revenue of NOK 2 260 083 and a profit of NOK 1 065 150, with positive equity of NOK 7 221 891. It has a registered CEO and board chair, and its 2025 accounts were audited. The most recent dated item found is "Godkjente årsregnskap" (category: Approved annual accounts), published 2026-09-22 (Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer). No risk flags were found in the registers checked (bankruptcy, liquidation, compulsory dissolution, negative equity, losses).

summary: ELTRON INSTALLASJON AS (org. no. 990 526 419) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2006-11-23. The register states no bankruptcy, liquidation or compulsory dissolution. Its main activity is NACE 43.210 (Elektrisk installasjonsarbeid). In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) operating revenue was NOK 2 260 083 and net income was NOK 1 065 150. CEO: Trond Håvard Ulland; board chair: Trond Håvard Ulland. Most recent dated item found (2026-09-22): "Godkjente årsregnskap" (category: Approved annual accounts) – Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer. 15 dated news/announcement items are listed with source links.

conclusion.text: BYKLE NÆRINGS SAMEIGE AS is an active private limited company in real estate activities, based in Bykle. Its employee count is not registered, so its headcount is unknown. In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) it reported revenue of NOK 294 000 and a profit of NOK 7 749, with positive equity of NOK 1 724 353. It has a registered CEO and board chair, and its 2025 accounts were audited.
